name: smwgraphics-bahamut-lagoon-desert-with-mountains
title: Bahamut Lagoon - Desert with Mountains
description:
This is a rip from the game Bahamut Lagoon. It's a desert BG with mountains in the distance.

The top-half was 256 colors in the original game, so I had to decrease the color depth.

This updated version does not overwrite the status bar palette. Instead it overwrites palettes 3 and 5.
